This article is a stub. Split Second Timing is the Australian distributor of
[ALGE-Timing](alge-timing.md) equipment, based in Dee Why, New South Wales, and it describes and
hosts the documents for ALGE's [SWIM 2000](../equipment/swimming/timers/alge-swim-2000.md)
swimming system.

See the [vendors overview](index.md) for the other companies this wiki covers.
